content.short: Zyfi is a Paymaster-as-a-Service on ZKsync and Base enabling gasless transactions with any ERC-20 token for all.
content.description: Zyfi is a pioneering decentralized infrastructure protocol designed to simplify the Web3 user experience through advanced Native Account Abstraction (ERC-4337). The platform provides a professional-grade "Paymaster-as-a-Service" that allows decentralized applications to offer gasless transactions, enabling users to pay for network fees using any of over 80 supported ERC-20 tokens instead of native ETH. This approach significantly lowers the barrier to entry for retail participants and fosters mass adoption by making on-chain interactions as intuitive as traditional web apps.
content.meta: Zyfi provides gasless transaction infrastructure and account abstraction tools. Discover Zyfi and other Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
